excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]表面坐落着一座类似大型机器的物体，其来源与功用尚未查明。
excerpt.en: On the surface of [From.GetName] sits what appears to be a large machine, of unknown origin and purpose.

sections.zh: 在[From.GetName]表面坐落着一座类似大型机器的物体，其来源与功用尚未查明。
sections.en: On the surface of [From.GetName] sits what appears to be a large machine, of unknown origin and purpose.

texts.zh:
进一步扫描表明机械仍在运转，而其目的至今仍然毫无头绪。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]表示自己从未见过这样的东西。其中有些材料似乎有些眼熟，但绝大部分都是见所未见的外星产物，其部件与结构也是一样。

机器似乎具备一个控制台，台上有一样十分显眼的物品：一柄由不明材料制成的大而弯曲的拉杆。
texts.en:
Further scans suggest the machine is still operational, though its purpose remains entirely unclear.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has never seen anything like it. Some of its materials look familiar, but most are strange and utterly alien as the design of its components.

The machine has what appears to be a console, with one item in particular standing out: a large crooked lever of unknown material.

tooltips.zh: 科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]拉下了奇怪的拉杆。
tooltips.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] pulls the strange lever.

tooltips.zh: 机器已经拆解，并对部件进行了回收。
tooltips.en: The machine is disassembled and its parts salvaged.

texts.zh:
在我们的科学家拉下拉杆后，机器迸出巨大的能量冲击，在虚空形成中扭曲和涟漪，在[system_one.GetName] 中撕出一个虫洞。

在剩余能量的消散后，虫洞及其附近区域稳定下来，现在看起来足够稳定，可以安全通过。至于在另一边等待我们的是什么，我们的科学家们并不那么确定。

机器本身重归沉寂，不再发出任何异常读数。
texts.en:
As our scientists pulled the lever the machine emitted a huge blast of energy that multiplied in shockwaves, twisting and rippling through the void, tearing open a wormhole in [system_one.GetName].

After the residuous energy diffused the wormhole and the immediate area around it settled and now appear to be stable enough for safe passage. As for what awaits us on the other side our scientists are not so sure.

The machine itself has since returned to its inactive state and no longer gives off any anomalous readings.

label.zh: 真是古怪。快拆开来看看吧。
label.en: How strange. Now take it apart.

tooltips.zh: 机器已经拆解，并对部件进行了回收。
tooltips.en: The machine is disassembled and its parts salvaged.

label.zh: 有点意思。快研究一下这机器。

tooltips.en:

£physics£ +7

texts.zh:
我们在[wormhole_system.GetName]星系的边缘疑似发现了一个天然形成的亚空间现象！该处的时空出现了裂隙，从而产生了一个"虫洞"。据[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]推断，此虫洞也许与星系中的其它虫洞通过亚空间相连。

这也就是说，我们的舰船有可能在数日之内就可以由星系的一端到达另一端，这取决于另外的虫洞的位置。不幸的是这个虫洞和大部分虫洞一样，长时间处于不稳定状态。即使有舰船敢接近，也会瞬间被撕成碎片。
texts.en:
We have detected what appears to be a naturally occurring subspace phenomenon on the edge of the [wormhole_system.GetName] system! A rift in the very fabric of space-time has formed here, creating a "wormhole" that, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] speculate, may provide a conduit through subspace to another wormhole located somewhere else in our galaxy.

Depending on where the second wormhole is located, this could potentially allow ships to travel from one end of the galaxy to the other in a matter of days. Unfortunately, this wormhole, like the vast majority of its kind, is inherently unstable. Any vessels foolish enough to pass through it would be ripped apart in seconds.

label.zh: 如果我们能将其稳定的话……
label.en: If it could somehow be stabilized...

texts.zh:
曲柄被拉动之后发生了什么还不清楚。

那个控制台不停闪烁，并发出巨大的震动。一股巨大的能量波直冲云霄，进入宇宙深处。附近的科学家都感到一股能量之风猛然吹过，但并没有任何感官上的直接证据。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]并不清楚发生了什么。外星机器随后立刻沉寂了下来，再也没有任何能量反应。
texts.en:
It is unclear what happened when the machine's lever was pulled.

Its console flickered, powerful vibrations could be felt, and then a wave of energy surged from the machine, expanding outwards into deep space. The scientists close by felt this wave push past them, but experienced no other sensory evidence of its passing.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is unsure what to make of it. The machine itself returned to its inactive state immediately thereafter, and no longer returns any energy readings.

label.zh: 真是古怪。快拆开来看看吧。
label.en: How strange. Now take it apart.

tooltips.en: The machine is disassembled and its parts salvaged.
